triggers.sys_api_budget_buckets_counts_ck_insert: CREATE TRIGGER "sys_api_budget_buckets_counts_ck_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "sys_api_budget_buckets" WHEN NOT (NEW.capacity >= 0 AND NEW.refill_rate >= 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'sys_api_budget_buckets_counts_ck'); END
